title: 30-Day JKD Fundamentals
description: Complete beginner's introduction to Jun Fan Gung Fu covering all basic techniques, footwork, and combinations. Perfect for those new to JKD.

days.notes: Focus on proper stance, guard position, and basic punching form. Quality over speed.
Master the foundational footwork. Maintain balance and posture throughout all movements.
Combine yesterday's footwork with punching. Start slow, focus on coordination.
Rest and recovery. Review mental notes on technique. Visualize proper form.
Introduction to basic combinations. Remember: economy of motion, straight line to target.
Learn the reverse footwork pattern. Compare with Step and Slide - notice the differences.
Integrate combinations with footwork. This is the foundation of JKD fighting method.
Week 1 complete! Rest day. Reflect on your progress. Tomorrow we add kicks.
First kicks session. Focus on balance, hip rotation, and chamber position.
Explosive forward movement. Essential for closing distance and attacking.
Longer combinations. Maintain power and speed throughout the sequence.
Combine kicks with explosive footwork. Perfect your fighting measure.
Extended combinations. Flow from one technique to the next without stopping.
Review week. Practice all punches and kicks separately. Build muscle memory.
Halfway point! Rest and celebrate your progress. Week 3 starts with trapping.
Introduction to Chi Sao fundamentals. Feel for opponent's energy and intentions.
Rhythmic footwork. Stay light on your feet, ready to change direction instantly.
Your first counter series. Defense is as important as offense in JKD.
Combine trapping sensitivity with dynamic footwork. Stay mobile while controlling.
Second counter series. Learn to respond to different attack angles.
Longest combination yet. Breathe, relax, and maintain technique under fatigue.
Week 3 complete! Rest day. We've covered a lot. Final week focuses on integration.
Advanced footwork with weight shifts. Crucial for evasion and angle creation.
Advanced Jun Fan Kickboxing series. Integrate everything you've learned.
Practice both counter series. Develop automatic defensive responses.
Combination review. Flow between different length sequences smoothly.
Advanced footwork with longest combinations. Challenge yourself!
Trapping flow into kickboxing combinations. The essence of JKD integration.
Final rest day. Tomorrow is graduation day. Review mentally all you've learned.
Final day! Complete workout touching all major categories. You've completed your JKD fundamentals journey. Congratulations!
